websiteDescription:
Hassle free Quick-Release table pedestal system without the need for large mounting holes in the deck. 
Features 
• Patented, revolutionary table hardware system 
• Quick release levers allows effortless take-down of table system for storage 
• Simple to use, simple to install. 
• Low-Profile deck ring creates minimal interference when table is stowed 
• No large centre hole in deck as is common with other table hardware systems 
• Marine grade polymer components resist corrosion 
• 57mm ribbed anodised aluminium stanchion is tapered at both ends 
• Individual components available if additional mounting locations are desired 
• U.S. PATENT 7,013,831 
Includes 
• Complete system includes deck ring, socket base, table mounting socket and 648mm stanchion tube
